scope: group-aware training OOF; 761 PepFlow <=15 aa samples (actual 11-15 aa) plus 2034 AF2/ColabFold 16-30 aa samples

architecture.base: frozen 3D-v2 ESM2 + pLDDT-aware C-alpha EGNN + full-atom chemical-site residual
architecture.source_conditioning: three-way generator one-hot encoded by a learned source encoder
architecture.missing_policy: hard-zero conformer residual and exact fallback to 3D-v2

decision.reason: The rank-stable multi-source structure expert improves full-training OOF MCC and AUPRC, but the frozen ProtT5 fusion loses MCC, AUROC, AUPRC and Brier relative to the current pilot250 hybrid default. External conformer-enabled validation is also absent.
